provenance.data_files: tests/checks/injector-file-provenance/{t_data,w_data,px_data}.txt, task-authored, 50 rows each, list-directed READ(unit,*) one value per line

policy.shape: Final injected particle count/total weight/px exactly equal the row count/sum/constant value of the authored data files.
policy.tolerance_origin: 1e-9 relative: no RNG is consumed by file injection, so this is an exact deterministic replay; the tiny tolerance absorbs IEEE double summation rounding only.
policy.determinism: No RNG in the file-injection path at all; single rank.

criteria.name: px_matches_px_data
criteria.rule: max relative |px - px_data value| <= 1e-9, both sides
